{{Top|leg}}
The '''Council of Eckless''' was the ruling body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eckless]]. They issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for the retrieval of the [[Black Sphere]] from [[Hahz Fallone]], and delegated [[Rusha]] to oversee the process.<ref name="TBS">{{WEGCite|story=The Black Sphere|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
